dsp GenBlownFlutePureLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.12 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.05 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.05 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6815

  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0

    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)

    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA

    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.12 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.05 * bright

    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b

    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b

dsp GenBlownFluteBreathyLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.12 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.05 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.16 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6670

dsp GenBlownFluteBreathyHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.12 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.05 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.16 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6735

dsp GenBlownFluteWindyLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.12 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.05 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.35 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6430

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.12 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.05 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.35 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6435

  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0

    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))

    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b

    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b

dsp GenBlownRecorderBreathyLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.22 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.12 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.16 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6541

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.22 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.12 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.16 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6643

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.07 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.06 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.02 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.05 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6869

dsp GenBlownPanPureHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.07 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.06 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.02 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.05 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6913

dsp GenBlownPanBreathyLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.07 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.06 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.02 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.16 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6736

blownPanBreathyHigh.source:
dsp GenBlownPanBreathyHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.07 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004 * veA - chiffA * 0.0)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let bright := 0.5 + colour
    let tone := sinpi(phA * 2.0) + sinpi(phA * 4.0) * 0.06 * bright + sinpi(phA * 6.0) * 0.02 * bright
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 2.0) / sr))
    let kb := 1.4
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (nz - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * envA * 0.55 + v1b * envA * 0.16 * 3.0 + v1b * chiffA * 0.6) * 1.2) * 0.6777
